D.9-4 3 Details of this Opportunity 3.1 Scope As described in Section 2, HTMPO has been exploring the HWO mission architecture trade space, following the recommendation of Astro2020. The focus of HWO-ICA is to enable broader/deeper exploration of the instrument trade space, with the goal of better understanding of the range of possible HWO instruments, their relative scientific returns, and their engineering and technology challenges including accommodation. HTMPO is interested in understanding if the suite of candidate instruments studied thus far (see Section 2) can be improved (e.g., by combining certain instrument capabilities in different ways and/or simplifying certain candidate instruments), what instruments could be considered for the additional bay that has thus far remained empty, and any other innovative ideas that the community may have. This program element therefore solicits instrument concept assessments that respond to the broad science goals of HWO, including: the search for life on Earth-like planets around nearby Sun-like stars; measuring the hidden drivers of galaxy growth and evolution; and studying the origin and evolution of elements in the universe. Additionally, this program element solicits instrument concept assessments that may also address areas of planetary science. See Section 3.8 for additional resources on HWO science cases. The candidate instrument capabilities listed below are within the scope of this opportunity. Other instrument capabilities not listed here may be within the scope, if the proposal convincingly demonstrates sufficient traceability to HWO science goals. • Coronagraphy (*see note below): - Near-IR coronagraphic imaging and spectroscopy - Near-UV coronagraphic imaging • Spectroscopy: - UV / visible integral field spectroscopy - UV / visible multi-object spectroscopy • Imaging: - High-resolution near-UV / visible / near-IR imaging - Visible wavelength high-precision astrometry - Observatory guiding and wavefront sensing *Note that visible coronagraphic imaging and spectroscopy are excluded from this opportunity, as the visible coronagraph is being studied as directed work within HTMPO. Proposals may address near-IR / near-UV coronagraphy as a stand-alone instrument or as an additional channel within the visible coronagraph. HWO is currently in the pre-formulation phase, thus this opportunity does not solicit proposals to develop flight hardware or support tools/systems (e.g., ground support equipment, software). Proposers should note that HWO-ICA awards do not imply inclusion in future HWO instrument requirements or designs, nor involvement in future HWO mission development; decisions regarding HWO flight instruments will be made by NASA at a later date.
